format:
  typst:
    papersize: a1
    margin:
      x: "0cm"
      y: "0cm"
---

```{dot}
#//| file: diagram.dot

digraph G {
    fontname="Arial"
    fontsize=10
    compound=true;
    
    // Reverting to the preferred Top-to-Bottom vertical flow
    rankdir=TD; 
    nodesep=0.4;
    ranksep=0.5;

    // Global node & edge formatting
    node [
        fontname="Arial", 
        fontsize=12, 
        shape=box, 
        style="filled,rounded", 
        fixedsize=true, 
        width=2.5, 
        height=0.8
    ];
    
    edge [
        fontname="Arial", 
        fontsize=10, 
        color="#64748B", 
        penwidth=1.5
    ];

    // --- Subgraphs ---
    
    // User Outputs 
    subgraph cluster_UO {
        label="User Outputs";
        labelloc="t"; 
        labeljust="l"; 
        fontname="Arial";
        fontsize=14;
        style="filled,rounded";
        fillcolor="#F0F9FF"; // Soft Light Blue
        color="#0284C7";     // Sky Blue Border
        
        I [label="Searching and\nfiltering", fillcolor="#E0F2FE", color="#0284C7", fontcolor="#0369A1"];
        J [label="Summary tables\n- CSV", fillcolor="#E0F2FE", color="#0284C7", fontcolor="#0369A1"];
        K [label="Summary plots\n- PNG", fillcolor="#E0F2FE", color="#0284C7", fontcolor="#0369A1"];
        L [label="Reports -\nHTML, PDF, Word", fillcolor="#E0F2FE", color="#0284C7", fontcolor="#0369A1"];
    }

     // Collaborative workflows 
    subgraph cluster_CW {
        label="Collaborative Workflows";
        labelloc="t"; 
        labeljust="l";
        fontname="Arial";
        fontsize=14;
        style="filled,rounded";
        fillcolor="#eddaf6"; // Soft Light Blue
        color="#ae1bed";     // Sky Blue Border
        
        E [label="Citation RIS file", fillcolor="#eddaf6", color="#ae1bed", fontcolor="#ae1bed"];
         F [label="Google Drive", fillcolor="#eddaf6", color="#ae1bed", fontcolor="#ae1bed"];
    }

    // Inputs Pipeline 
    subgraph cluster_IP {
        label="Inputs Pipeline";
        labelloc="t"; 
        labeljust="l";
        fontname="Arial";
        fontsize=14;
        style="filled,rounded";
        fillcolor="#F4FBF7"; // Soft Light Green
        color="#137333";     // Sage Green Border
        
        A [label="User created\n'categories' Excel file", fillcolor="#E6F4EA", color="#137333", fontcolor="#137333"];
        B [label="Zotero library\nor collection", fillcolor="#E6F4EA", color="#137333", fontcolor="#137333"];
        C [label="CSV file exported\nfrom Zotero", fillcolor="#E6F4EA", color="#137333", fontcolor="#137333"];     
    }

    // Core Ecosystem
    subgraph cluster_CE {
        label="Lit-tag\nCore\nEcosystem";
        labelloc="t"; 
        labeljust="l";
        fontname="Arial";
        fontsize=14;
        style="filled,rounded";
        fillcolor="#EEF2FF"; // Soft Light Indigo
        color="#3730A3";     // Indigo Border
        
        D [label="Lit-tag builder\nmodule", fillcolor="#4F46E5", color="#3730A3", fontcolor="#FFFFFF", style="filled,rounded,bold"];
        G [label="Lit-tag CSV\ndatabase", fillcolor="#FFF7ED", color="#EA580C", fontcolor="#C2410C"];
        H [label="Lit-tag viewer\nmodule", fillcolor="#4F46E5", color="#3730A3", fontcolor="#FFFFFF", style="filled,rounded,bold"];
    }

    // --- Process Flow Connections ---
    A -> D [taillabel="Defines tags\nand notes", labeldistance= 6, labelangle=-30];
    A -> H [label="  Controls tag UI"];
    B -> C [label="  Export citations"];
    C -> D [taillabel="Import citations", labeldistance= 4, labelangle=-85];
    #D -> E [label="Export citations"];
    D -> E [taillabel="Export citations", labeldistance= 20, labelangle=-6];
    D -> G [dir=both, label="  Create and update"];
    G -> F [dir=both, taillabel="Sync for sharing", labeldistance= 10, labelangle=-18];
    G -> H [label="  Data exploration"];
    H -> I [label="  Interactive"];
    I -> J [label=" View and\nexport"];
    I -> K [label=" View and\nexport"];
    I -> L [label="View and\nexport"];
}
```
